title: Should You Help Mattia in GTA 6? A Dilemma Guide
description: Mattia is about to be a father in GTA 6, but is it worth risking your life to help him after all the chaos? Read our take.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The GTA 6 Dilemma: To Help Mattia or Not?

As discussion surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to build within the gaming community, players are looking closely at the various choices and character interactions they will face in the game. Recently, attention has been drawn to a specific character named Mattia, who is on the verge of becoming a father. However, after all the chaos and trouble he has put you through, the big question on many players' minds is whether it is genuinely worth risking your life to help him out.

### Navigating Chaos and Conscience

In massive open-world titles like the GTA series, narrative choices often blur the lines between right and wrong. Mattia's character presents a classic dilemma: on one hand, his past actions have subjected you to significant chaos; on the other hand, the prospect of him becoming a father introduces a human element that complicates simple retaliation or abandonment. Gaming media outlets have started highlighting these nuanced character dynamics, sparking debates among fans regarding how they plan to handle such situations when diving into the game.

### The Impact of Player Choices

While the exact consequences, rewards, or specific narrative branches tied to helping Mattia remain part of the broader gameplay discovery, the inclusion of these moral crossroads elevates the overall immersion of GTA 6. Players must weigh the risks and rewards of loyalty versus self-preservation in a world where actions notoriously have consequences.

## Editor's Take

Characters like Mattia bring a layer of unpredictability and personal stakes to open-world games. While the chaos he causes might make you want to walk away, the impending fatherhood adds a compelling narrative twist. Whether the risk is worth it likely depends on what kind of playthrough you are aiming for—pure survival or engaging with every messy human story the game throws your way.
